I reviewed each key item against the record and checked every figure, owner and date against the transcript's final version.

**Pairing notes:**
- The record decomposes several compound key items (e1 → items 3/4/8; e2 → items 1/2/7; a2 → items 10/11). I paired each key item with the record item carrying its core content and figures, then judged the leftovers on their own merits.
- All corrected figures landed right: closing is October 30 (not the misheard October 13), the rollover uses the $387,240 vested balance (not $430,000), and i1's due date is October 6 (moved from Friday September 18).
- Item 15 ("Sign the IRA application...") is the client-side half of item 14's "send for signature" — a split, not a separate agreed action.
- None of the six NOT ACTIONS appear as account actions or action items. COBRA surfaces only inside life event 3, correctly flagged as "no action to be taken."

key_items.note: Item 4 carries the Venholt role, Oct 5 start, $265,000 base, $40,000 sign-on (repayable within 12 months) and $15,000 lump sum, all matching the transcript. The Sept 25 last day and the $42,760 forfeiture sit in items 3 and 8, graded separately as extras.

Woodbury to Franklin move with Tennessee residency as of Oct 1; pack Sept 28, load/depart Sept 29, arrive Sept 30, keys Oct 1 at 9:00 all match Graham's account. Lease terms and the Oct 5 school start are split into items 2 and 7.

Listed $619,900, contract $604,000, contingency off Oct 9, mail-away closing Friday Oct 30 (the corrected date, not the misheard Oct 13), $392,000 purchase, $48,000 remodel, ~$128,000 gain under the $500,000 exclusion, ~$214,000 payoff, $353,800 net. All correct.

Fully remote approval from Tollefsrud Mutual, same manager and team, two to three days a quarter in Minneapolis. 'Approved Thursday September 10, 2026' correctly resolves Graham's 'last Thursday' from the Sept 15 Tuesday meeting.

Direct rollover of the vested balance to a new Ferrant IRA, check payable to Ferrant FBO, nothing withheld, Graham primary / Theo and Ingrid 50-50 contingent. Uses the corrected $387,240 as of Sept 15, not the $430,000 total.
New separate joint house account at Ferrant receiving the title company wire, estimated $353,800. The ladder half of this key item appears as item 11, graded as an extra.
Pause the recurring $2,000 monthly investment for October through December, restart January 2027. Amount and window both correct.
Hold already in place on the joint account, no gain-realizing sales until after Oct 1 so gains land on the Tennessee side. Amount NOT_FOUND is right; the key specifies no amount.

Jules Marchetti, due Tuesday Oct 6, 2026, correctly noted as moved back from Friday Sept 18 so the termination posts with Grevholm's recordkeeper. Beneficiary split and the $387,240 vested figure are right.
Jules Marchetti (reassigned from Hollis, who is out Sept 21-25), due Friday Sept 25, 2026. Packet contents, both CPA questions and the copy list to Hollis and the clients all match.
Graham Brennock, before Thursday Oct 1, 2026. Weekday check confirms Oct 1, 2026 is a Thursday. Purpose (stop Minnesota withholding, switch to Tennessee) is accurate.
Renata Brennock, due her first day Monday Oct 5, 2026. $24,500 combined limit and ~$5,500 of remaining room are right, plus the spread-not-front-load instruction and the match true-up question.
Both clients named as owners; Tennessee licenses, Williamson County voter registration and both cars, due within the 30-day window by end of October 2026.
Jules Marchetti, Friday Oct 23, 2026, correctly derived as one week ahead of the Oct 30 closing.
Renata Brennock, due tonight Tuesday Sept 15, 2026, with the correct $2,000 amount and the reason (the draft pulls on the 1st).

extra_items.note: Twelve-month Franklin lease at $4,150 a month from Oct 1 and the intent to buy in roughly twelve months when the lease is up are both stated by Graham and Renata. Adds lease terms that item 1 does not carry.

Last day Friday Sept 25, Grevholm coverage through Sept 30, the four-day gap with no action and retroactive COBRA within 60 days are all in the transcript. Correctly framed as a life event rather than an action, matching n6.
Kids start school Monday Oct 5 and Theo's Brentwood club team are both established; Ingrid's age of 11 is stated. Adds detail beyond the relocation entry.

Approximately $430,000 total balance, $387,240 vested, $42,760 unvested at 60% on a six-year schedule and forfeited on departure. Correctly labels $430,000 as the total rather than the rollover amount.

Ladder placed the day the wire lands, four rungs of $85,000 at 3/6/9/12 months totaling $340,000, with roughly $13,800 left in the money market. All figures match Hollis's math; it is the investment step of the house account plan rather than a restatement of item 10.
Renata signing the IRA application and distribution form is the client-side half of item 14's 'send for signature' step, with no separately agreed task or date in the meeting.
